title: Identity main librarian reference is mistaken for a user edit
symptom: The unedited librarian reference shipped by the just-integrated identity change is classified edited, preventing its safe upgrade to the learning bundle.
trigger: Install the exact identity-main librarian reference and run the learning helper skill status and update.
expected: Recognize the known predecessor, update it to current, and still preserve truly edited copies.
actual: The named integration regression gets edited instead of known-outdated at the first status assertion.

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: This is a new predecessor digest introduced by the identity-main integration, not a user-edited bundle or the earlier checkpoint predecessor.
status: open -> verified. The strictly later named regression passes after adding the missing identity-main predecessor digest. Real edited-copy preservation is asserted by the same test.
